qualifier: by TTP-family zinc-finger proteins and KSRP
name: TTP, BRF1 and KSRP AU-rich mRNA destabilization
rationale: All three members are ARE-binding proteins (TTP/ZFP36, BRF1/ZFP36L1, KSRP) that destabilize mRNA, distinct from confusables built on decapping/exonuclease decay, AUF1/HuR control, or stress granules.

qualifier: SHC1 and GRB2 adaptor events
name: SHC1 and GRB2 adaptor events in ERBB signaling
rationale: Every member is SHC1 or GRB2 recruitment downstream of EGFR, ERBB2 or ERBB4, whereas confusables carry PI3K, PLCG1, GRB7, GAB1 and transactivation branches.

qualifier: ligand sequestration; lateral mesoderm left/right asymmetry
name: Extracellular ligand sequestration limiting nodal signaling
rationale: Members concern extracellular sequestration of BMP/nodal ligands and negative regulation of nodal in lateral mesoderm asymmetry, unlike confusables centred on organ laterality, BMP/TGF-beta SMAD signaling, somitogenesis or endothelium.

qualifier: with inositol phosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis
name: PTEN-AKT signaling control and inositol polyphosphate synthesis
rationale: Members cover PTEN regulation, AKT targets and negative PI3K/AKT regulation together with nuclear/cytosolic inositol (pyro)phosphate synthesis, while confusables add pyrophosphate hydrolysis and serine phosphorylation terms instead.

core: Nucleotide-sugar donor supply for N-linked glycosylation
qualifier: UDP-GlcNAc and UDP-glucose; GFPT1/ALG14 myasthenic syndromes
name: UDP-GlcNAc and UDP-glucose supply for N-glycosylation
rationale: Members are UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucose and dolichyl-phosphate-glucose synthesis feeding N-glycosylation (including GFPT1/ALG14 congenital myasthenic defects), distinct from sialic acid, GPI anchor and N-glycan trimming confusables.

core: Non-cyclooxygenase polyunsaturated fatty acid oxylipin metabolism
qualifier: lipoxygenase and cytochrome P450 branches: leukotrienes, pro-resolving mediators
name: Lipoxygenase and P450 eicosanoids, leukotrienes and pro-resolving mediators
rationale: Members are lipoxygenase, epoxygenase and omega-hydroxylase products of arachidonic, DHA and DPA (leukotrienes, HETEs, EETs, lipoxins, resolvins, maresins, protectins), whereas confusables add the cyclooxygenase/prostanoid branch.

qualifier: bone marrow niche and progenitor output
name: Hematopoietic stem cell homeostasis in bone marrow
rationale: Members regulate HSC proliferation, differentiation, homeostasis and bone marrow hemopoiesis, while confusables concern specific myeloid, B or thymic T lineage differentiation or pluripotent stem cell maintenance.

qualifier: with late endosome/multivesicular body-lysosome fusion
name: Autophagosome biogenesis and autophagosome/late endosome-lysosome fusion
rationale: Members regulate autophagosome assembly and maturation and the fusion of autophagosomes, late endosomes and MVBs with lysosomes, while confusables shift to selective autophagy, phagosome fusion or Golgi-lysosome transport.

qualifier: with tRNA processing, modification and transport
name: Mitochondrial RNA and tRNA processing, modification and turnover
rationale: Members cover tRNA end processing, splicing, modification and transport plus mitochondrial mRNA/rRNA modification, stability and mitoribosome assembly, whereas confusables add mitochondrial translation, transcription, DNA replication or pseudouridylation.

qualifier: glucagon-PKA signaling over gluconeogenesis and lipolysis
name: Glucagon-PKA fasting control of gluconeogenesis and lipolysis
rationale: Members are glucagon/PKA, PDE3B and AMPK-ChREBP control of gluconeogenesis and triglyceride breakdown, unlike confusables on glucose-sensing ChREBP, insulin/adiponectin, LXR lipogenesis or glycogen.

core: Dendritic arbor and postsynaptic actin remodeling
qualifier: driven by BDNF-TrkB (NTRK2) signaling to RAC1/CDK5
name: BDNF-TrkB-driven dendritic arborization and postsynaptic actin remodeling
rationale: Members link BDNF/NTRK2, EPHB and RHO GTPase signaling to dendrite branching, filopodia and postsynaptic actin, while confusables center on NMDAR-RAC1, synaptic plasticity and PSD maintenance.

qualifier: mRNA, tRNA and ribosomal subunit cargo
name: Nuclear export of mRNA, tRNA and ribosomal subunits
rationale: Most members are export of mature mRNAs, tRNA and pre-ribosomal subunits through the nuclear pore, whereas confusables cover NPC assembly, protein import/export, or nuclear RNA synthesis and processing.

core: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor binding and resistance
qualifier: PDGFR mutants
name: TKI binding and drug resistance of PDGFR mutants
rationale: All members describe PDGFR mutant binding of or resistance to TKIs, distinguishing the theme from the parallel FLT3 and KIT mutant themes.

qualifier: host-pathogen ion and iron competition
name: Phagosome acidification, fusion and ion/iron competition with pathogens
rationale: Members concern phagosome acidification, phagosome-lysosome fusion, PMN phagocytolysis and ion/iron exchange at the host-pathogen interface, while confusables focus on Mtb immune evasion, heme uptake or neutrophil granule programmes.

qualifier: palate, outer ear, thymus, parathyroid, thyroid, spleen
name: Craniofacial, palate and pharyngeal gland/lymphoid organ development
rationale: Members are palate, face, outer ear and viscerocranium morphogenesis plus thymus, parathyroid, thyroid and spleen development, unlike confusables on outflow tract/trachea, exocrine glands, inner ear or limbs.

qualifier: ERBB2 mutants
name: Therapeutic inhibition and drug resistance of ERBB2 mutants
rationale: Members are ERBB2 drug inhibition and resistance of ERBB2 kinase-domain and TMD/JMD mutants to specific drugs, while confusables cover oncogenic signaling by mutant receptors or TKI resistance in ALK, KIT and PDGFR.

qualifier: nicotinic receptors, neuromuscular junction, clostridial neurotoxins
name: Cholinergic neuromuscular transmission, nicotinic receptors and clostridial neurotoxins
rationale: Members center on acetylcholine synthesis, release, choline uptake, nicotinic and other ligand-gated channels and botulinum/tetanus toxin blockade, unlike confusables on GPCR muscarinic/serotonin signaling, NMJ assembly or amino-acid transmitter transport.

core: Transcription by RNA polymerases I and III
qualifier: elongation and termination stages
name: RNA polymerase I and III transcription elongation and termination
rationale: Members are Pol I/III elongation and termination with 5S and 5'-ETS rRNA steps, while confusables carry promoter opening, initiation and rRNA expression control.

qualifier: fatty acid receptors and neurohormonal inputs
name: Fatty acid and neurohormonal control of islet hormone secretion
rationale: Members are free fatty acid/hydroxycarboxylic acid receptors, GLP-1, acetylcholine and adrenaline regulating insulin and glucagon secretion, while confusables emphasize incretin synthesis, glucagon-type receptors and cAMP or hepatic glucagon-PKA signaling.

qualifier: methylmalonic acidemia and homocystinuria defects
name: Intracellular cobalamin processing and methylmalonic acidemia/homocystinuria
rationale: Members are cellular cobalamin processing to cofactors for MUT and MTR, propionyl-CoA catabolism and their inherited defects, while confusables cover dietary cobalamin uptake and plasma transport or other organic acidemias.

qualifier: TAK1-driven JNK and p38
name: TAK1-driven JNK and p38 stress kinase cascade regulation
rationale: Members regulate JNK and p38 stress-activated cascades including TAK1 and ALPK1 activation, whereas confusables add AP-1 outputs, ERK feedback, or upstream TLR/NOD receptor routes.

core: Phase I oxidative metabolism of xenobiotics
qualifier: FMO/CYP oxidation of amines and plant-derived compounds
name: FMO and CYP oxidation of amines and plant compounds
rationale: Members are FMO and CYP N-oxidation and oxidative demethylation of amines, alkaloids, phenylpropanoids and monoterpenoids, unlike confusables dominated by general xenobiotic catabolism and conjugation (sulfonation, acetylation, methylation).

qualifier: reduced release, enhanced uptake, spontaneous transmission
name: Limiting synaptic neurotransmitter availability and spontaneous release
rationale: The three members reduce neurotransmitter secretion, enhance its uptake or tune spontaneous transmission, distinct from confusables on synaptic vesicle cycling or catecholamine-specific transporters.

qualifier: phosphatidylserine exposure and apoptotic cell clearance
name: Phosphatidylserine translocation, exposure and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Most members concern flippase/scramblase control of phosphatidylserine, its exposure on apoptotic cells and platelets, and efferocytosis, with membrane repair and mechanoresponse terms, unlike confusables on apical trafficking, ER lipid transfer or surfactant.

qualifier: COPI, endosome-Golgi retrograde and lysosomal sorting
name: Golgi organization and COPI, endosome-Golgi and lysosomal traffic
rationale: Members span Golgi structure, COPI budding, Golgi-ER and endosome-Golgi retrograde transport, lysosomal targeting and Rab/ARF regulation, while confusables carry COPII ER export, ER protein targeting and Rab prenylation.
